notablePrerequisites: Kaya's Ghostform attached to Blood Pet.
description:
Activate Blood Pet by sacrificing it, adding {B}.
Blood Pet dies, triggering Salvaging Station and Kaya's Ghostform.
Resolve the Salvaging Station trigger, untapping it.
Resolve the Kaya's Ghostform trigger, returning Blood Pet from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Activate Salvaging Station by tapping it, returning Kaya's Ghostform from your graveyard to the battlefield attached to Blood Pet.
Repeat.
